practice_observation: Independent review earned its place: the reviewer showed that the ruling's own premise (a margin is needed against Lanczos4 spill at the protect boundary) did not hold in this kernel, because patches are blended by region maps resampled with the same filter, so the gate reads 0 even at margin 0; the 4 px margin was making a hard halo, so it became 2 px plus an 8 px fade. The first spindle-foot repair left a dark violet cloud and needed a second round. Rewriting a dated evidence table in an acceptance-owned file was caught and reverted; new numbers belong in the implementer's own files. EC-0's assets kept moving after acceptance because later studies (rain, glass, steam, neon) probe them, which is why the asset pass is batched. Costs: main moved four times under #61 and the force-push denial turned each rebase into a new PR (four wasted verify jobs, about 11 h of queue); checking CI once and never polling left the session idle through the merge; the Forgejo token cannot edit PR bodies, so stale bodies remain on superseded PRs.
